etsy.title: Ready for a Dog? Family Readiness Kit, Kids Pet Chore Chart, Dog Budget Planner, Cat and Dog Introduction Plan, Printable PDF
etsy.description:
Your little one asks for a dog every single day? This gentle 4-week printable kit turns that wish into a calm family project.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages, US Letter + A4 PDF included)
• How to use this kit – a simple 4-week plan
• Family Readiness Checklist – home, time, money, family
• Monthly Dog Budget – start-up costs and monthly lines
• Little Helper Chart – picture-based jobs for pre-readers (ages 3+)
• 30-Day Practice Challenge – one tiny task a day
• Cat & Dog Introduction Plan – step by step, keeps your cat safe
• Our Dog Promise – sign it together, draw your dream dog

PERFECT FOR
• Families with a cat whose child wants a dog
• Parents who want to teach responsibility before saying yes
• A thoughtful gift for a family thinking about adopting

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

PLEASE NOTE
This planner is a planning aid, not veterinary or legal advice. Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.
For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
